summary: The audit checks the 90 units in the major, MATH 19, 20 and 21, a WIM course from your focus area's list, and a capstone course with C- or better. ENGR 1, ENGR 2, ENGR 103 and MS&E 475A/B never count toward the units. The School of Engineering lists are not in this program's data, so you move in by hand, and an advisor checks: math electives to reach 21 math units, 17 units of science, a Technology in Society course, two Engineering Fundamentals (C- or better), 34 units of engineering depth (C- or better, 2.5 GPA in engineering courses) and the relevant additional courses that bring the major to 90 units. IntroSems, SIC and SC courses do not count, AP and transfer credit need the Dean's Office, and honors needs a thesis and a 3.5 GPA.

totals.label: Courses that do not count toward IDMEN units
totals.why: Additional Coursework: "Introductory Seminar courses (IntroSems), 1- or 2-unit survey/professional/personal interest courses (such as MS&E 475, ENGR 103, or ME 104B), ENGR 1 or 2, Student Initiated Courses (SIC), or Sophomore College (SC) courses may not be used to satisfy unit requirements in the IDMEN program." The named courses are capped at 0 (MS&E 475 is now listed as 475A and 475B; there is no ME 104B). IntroSems, SIC and SC courses are not a subject or number range.
